ui.shell.collapsible_app_logo.local_oper.note: Expanded wordmark beside the icon; collapsed icon accessible name.

ui.shell.panel_rail.panels.note: Names the toolbar holding the run, console, browser, canvas, code-review and asks doors.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub.note: The public catalogue for discovering and installing agents.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agents.note: The operator-owned agent roster, not the public catalogue.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agents.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.aida_missed.note: Names the chief-of-staff row with unread messages; singular and plural must agree with count. The number skeleton disables grouping to preserve the original English decimal count spelling even at 1000; cardinal selection remains numeric.

placeholders.name: User-configured chief-of-staff display name, verbatim.
placeholders.count: Number of missed messages; ICU plural cardinal.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.aida_working.note: Chief-of-staff row while a turn is running; no completion implied.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.browser.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.browser_wait.note: Names browser approvals waiting for the operator.

placeholders.count: Uncapped pending count rendered as an existing decimal string.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.close_sideba.note: Describes what pressing the sidebar toggle will do: dismiss the narrow-screen drawer.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.collapse_sid.note: Describes what pressing the sidebar toggle will do: reduce the desktop sidebar to icons.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.expand_sideb.note: Describes what pressing the sidebar toggle will do: restore desktop navigation labels.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.mesh.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.mesh_waiting.note: Names mesh requests waiting for the operator.

placeholders.count: Uncapped pending count rendered as an existing decimal string.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.new_chat.note: Stages an untargeted conversation draft; does not immediately send a message.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.new_chat_sho.note: Same new-chat action as the visible button, with its platform-specific chord.

placeholders.shortcut: Keyboard chord already formatted for the platform; preserve verbatim.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.projects.note: Workstreams and milestones, not filesystem folders.
ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.projects.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.schedules.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search.note: Opens the everything command palette; chats have a separate shortcut.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search_acces.note: Everything palette versus conversation-only quick switcher; do not collapse the two actions into one.

placeholders.everything: Platform shortcut for the everything palette.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.search_toolt.note: Everything palette versus conversation-only quick switcher; do not collapse the two actions into one.

placeholders.everything: Platform shortcut for the everything palette.

ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.settings.length: Single sidebar row; aim for 1–2 words.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.account_se.note: Profile-row press opens account preferences when there is no reconnect action.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.account_un.note: Account read failed; do not imply the user signed out or the account was deleted.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.checking_a.note: Replaces the account display name while Radient account data is unresolved; retain ellipsis.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.privacy_an.note: Account dropdown privacy/security entry; this extraction does not alter its interaction.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.reconnect_.role: menu action, profile-row hint and tooltip
ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.reconnect_.note: Opens Settings with Radient preselected so the refused account connection can be repaired.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.settings.note: Opens the main application Settings page from the profile dropdown.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.sign_out.note: Signs out and reloads the app to clear authentication state; not a quit action.

ui.shell.user_profile_sidebar.user.note: Only the ordinary signed-out placeholder, not an account failure.
